name: OutboundEngine
description_en:
OutboundEngine is a managed relationship-marketing service with software for campaigns, contacts and follow-up. Its team creates industry-oriented newsletters and social content, while customers provide branding and contacts, inspect upcoming campaigns and act on engagement signals. This is a different evaluation from configuring a general event-driven journey builder.

The documented operating loop is to prepare a contact source, allow verification and scheduled distribution, inspect contact/campaign results, and personally follow up using the surfaced context. Custom campaign creation is package-dependent. The useful questions are who actually receives a campaign, how to stop a specific send and which human still owns the conversation—not whether a dashboard score guarantees a sale.
description_zh:
OutboundEngine 是带有活动、联系人及跟进软件的托管关系营销服务。其团队制作行业导向的邮件及社交内容，客户提供品牌及联系人，检查即将发送的活动，并根据互动信号跟进。其评估方式不同于配置通用事件驱动旅程创建器。

文档运营闭环是准备联系人来源、等待验证及定时分发、检查联系人／活动结果，再根据显示的上下文亲自跟进。自定义活动创建受套餐约束。重要问题是谁实际收到活动、如何停止某次发送，以及谁继续负责对话，而不是把仪表盘分数当作成交保证。

core_features.explanation_en: Studio-prepared content moves through draft and scheduled campaign states.
core_features.explanation_zh: Studio 制作内容，经过草稿及计划发送状态。

core_features.name_zh: 按套餐提供自定义活动
core_features.explanation_en: The builder supports recipient selection, content and scheduled email/social publishing.
core_features.explanation_zh: 创建器支持选择收件人、内容及定时邮件／社交发布。

core_features.explanation_en: Active, pending and inactive reasons explain send eligibility.
core_features.explanation_zh: 活动、待验证及非活动原因说明发送资格。

core_features.explanation_en: Cards surface campaign engagement, requests and referrals for personal follow-up.
core_features.explanation_zh: 卡片显示活动互动、咨询及推荐，供个人跟进。

en: Editorial fit: relationship-led service businesses seeking recurring managed content and personal follow-up prompts.
Editorial mismatch: teams whose requirement is a fully programmable real-time event journey engine; that capability was not established.
zh: 编辑判断的适用场景：希望获得周期托管内容和个人跟进提示的关系驱动服务企业。
编辑判断的不适用需求：要求完全可编排实时事件旅程引擎的团队，本文未确认该能力。
use_cases.basis: Editorial workflow examples; not observed customer outcomes.

steps.en: Confirm service/package scope, commitment and branding before supplying a small intended contact cohort.
steps.zh: 提供小范围目标联系人前确认服务／套餐、承诺期及品牌。

steps.en: Verify source ownership, upload timing and active/pending/inactive reasons.
steps.zh: 确认来源编辑权、上传时间及活动／待验证／非活动原因。

steps.en: Preview a specific campaign and inspect readiness, recipients and social opt-out controls.
steps.zh: 预览具体活动，检查就绪状态、收件人及社交退出控制。

steps.en: Review contact-level outcomes and choose a personal follow-up; hiding a card does not suppress email.
steps.zh: 检查联系人结果并选择个人跟进；隐藏卡片不会停止邮件。

items.en: Cross-client industry deduplication can suppress a valid address and cannot be assumed resolved by re-uploading it.
items.zh: 跨客户行业去重可抑制有效邮箱，不能假设重新上传可解决。

items.en: Campaign Builder is package-dependent, and source sync provider availability has not been tested.
items.zh: Campaign Builder 受套餐约束，来源同步服务商可用性未测试。

items.en: No confirmed programmatic journey re-entry, retry/recall timing, cross-channel rollback or measured delivery guarantee.
items.zh: 未确认可编排旅程重入、重试／撤回时机、跨渠道回滚或实测投递保证。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: Actual public cards: Essential $199/mo with 500 contacts; Value $299/mo with 3,000; Premium $499/mo with 10,000. Table lists two managed email campaigns/month and 1/2/4 specialty blocks respectively. FAQ: twelve-month initial commitment, then month-to-month. Active-only package counting is described in contact help. Exact package add-ons, taxes, cancellation and overage terms not verified; no normalized price or sustained free entitlement assigned.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 实读公开卡片：Essential $199／月含 500 联系人，Value $299 含 3,000，Premium $499 含 10,000。表中每月两次托管邮件，专属内容块分别 1／2／4。FAQ：首次承诺十二个月，此后逐月。联系人帮助描述套餐仅统计活动者。未核实准确附加项、税费、取消及超额条款；不生成标准化价格或持续免费权限。

sections.title_en: Prepare the account before the managed schedule starts
sections.title_zh: 托管日程开始前准备账户
sections.en: The pricing FAQ says setup depends on receiving account information such as logo, contact list and branding preferences. The Studio guide describes advance campaign previews, with content moving from Draft to Scheduled when finalized. For an editorial local-service-business pilot, review identity, links, audience and a specific upcoming campaign before launch. This service supplies recurring marketing content; the originals reviewed do not establish a user-programmable graph of arbitrary purchase events, waits and API actions.
sections.zh: 价格 FAQ 说设置取决于收到标志、联系人列表及品牌偏好等账户信息。Studio 指南描述预先预览，内容完成后由 Draft 转为 Scheduled。编辑示例：本地服务企业试点应在启动前检查身份、链接、受众及某次即将发送活动。该服务供应周期营销内容；实读原文不能确认用户可编排任意购买事件、等待及 API 动作图。

sections.title_en: A synchronized source owns the editable contact data
sections.title_zh: 同步来源掌握可编辑联系人数据
sections.en: The sync FAQ says imported source contacts are edited in that source; each sync adds, updates and removes contacts to mirror it. Disconnecting stops updates but leaves previously synced contacts in OutboundEngine and makes local editing available. For an editorial CRM handoff, test one changed field and one source removal before a larger connection, and verify the currently supported provider. The article names legacy providers, so their continued availability is not established. Disconnection alone is not a marketing-suppression action.
sections.zh: 同步 FAQ 说来源联系人应在来源中编辑；每次同步会新增、更新及移出联系人以保持一致。断开会停止更新，但保留已同步联系人，并允许本地编辑。编辑示例：CRM 交接应先测试一个字段变化及一次来源移出，再做大范围连接，并确认当前支持服务商。文章包含旧服务商名称，不能确认其持续可用。断开同步本身不是停止营销动作。

sections.title_en: Upload time and verification affect the first campaign
sections.title_zh: 上传时间及验证影响首个活动
sections.en: The cutoff guide requires an upload at least one hour before a scheduled newsletter; support-handled submissions need at least a business day. New contacts enter Pending and receive the first newsletter in small batches over several days during optimization. The 2026 status guide allows up to one campaign cycle for verification. Therefore an uploaded contact is not necessarily an immediate recipient. Inspect pending/active status and allow the documented processing path before treating partial delivery as an automation failure. No list was uploaded here.
sections.zh: 截止指南要求至少在计划邮件前一小时上传；由支持处理的提交需至少一个工作日。新联系人先进入 Pending，在优化期间分几天小批接收首封邮件。2026 状态指南允许最多一个活动周期完成验证。因此已上传联系人不一定立即成为收件人。应先检查待验证／活动状态，并考虑文档处理路径，再把部分发送判断为自动化失败。本次未上传列表。

sections.title_en: Inactive reasons include more than a bad address
sections.title_zh: 非活动原因不只是错误地址
sections.en: The April 2026 guide includes unsubscribe, spam report, disabled, shared-role address and domain restrictions. DEDUPED means the address already belongs to another OutboundEngine client’s list within the same industry under a first-come policy; it is not ordinary duplicate removal within your own file. Disabled preserves the contact while stopping future campaigns; unsubscribe also stops marketing sends. Check the actual reason before retrying or reimporting. The platform’s active-only package count does not mean every stored record is eligible for a campaign.
sections.zh: 2026 年 4 月指南包括退订、垃圾举报、停用、共享角色邮箱及域名限制。DEDUPED 表示同一行业另一 OutboundEngine 客户列表已按先到原则占用该地址，并非自己文件内普通去重。Disabled 保留联系人但停止未来活动；退订同样停止营销发送。重试或重新导入前应检查实际原因。套餐仅统计活动联系人，不等于所有已存记录都可接收活动。

sections.title_en: Managed opt-out and custom readiness are different controls
sections.title_zh: 托管退出发送与自定义就绪是不同控制
sections.en: Managed campaigns normally follow the service schedule; Opt Out can stop the selected campaign and separately choose whether its related social streams are also suppressed. Custom campaigns instead start as Draft and are not sent if still Draft when their time passes; switching to Ready schedules them. Their recipient selector defaults to all contacts unless narrowed to tags or selected people. For an internal test, inspect the explicit recipient selection and final status rather than assuming a saved draft is safely scheduled or an email opt-out always cancels social posts.
sections.zh: 托管活动通常遵循服务日程；Opt Out 可停止选定活动，并单独选择是否抑制相关社交发布。自定义活动则从 Draft 开始，计划时间到达时若仍为 Draft 就不发送；切为 Ready 后安排发送。收件人默认全部联系人，除非缩小为标签或选定人员。内部测试应检查明确的收件选择和最终状态，不能认为保存草稿就已安排，也不能认为邮件退出总会取消社交发布。

sections.title_en: A contact card is a prompt for a conversation
sections.title_zh: 联系人卡片是对话提示
sections.en: Cards reflect signals such as opens/clicks across the latest three campaigns, a contact request or a referral response. They surface context and suggested actions, but do not independently verify buying intent. Removing a homepage card explicitly leaves the person receiving email; it only clears that view. For an editorial follow-up routine, read the signal, inspect the contact’s history and choose a personal response. Campaign reports provide sent/delivered/open/click counts and contact details, not proof of incremental sales or independently confirmed inbox placement.
sections.zh: 卡片反映最近三次活动的打开／点击、咨询或推荐回复等信号，显示上下文和建议动作，但不独立验证购买意图。移除首页卡片明确不会停止此人的邮件，只清除该视图。编辑示例：跟进日常应阅读信号、检查联系人历史，再选择个人回复。活动报告提供发送／投递／打开／点击及联系人详情，不能证明增量销售或独立确认收件箱位置。

sections.title_en: A scheduled post still needs an authorized social connection
sections.title_zh: 定时发布仍需有效社交连接
sections.en: The social guide says third-party connections can require reauthorization and recommends checking their status. Its dated LinkedIn interval is not a current provider SLA verified here. The custom builder documents separate Facebook/LinkedIn post fields, so inspect the intended page/account, post and link as well as the newsletter. If publishing fails, first check the actual connection and campaign state; the reviewed originals do not establish automatic replay, retry timing or a unified cross-channel rollback. No social account was connected or changed.
sections.zh: 社交指南说第三方连接可能需要重新授权，建议检查状态。其中旧 LinkedIn 间隔不是本次已核实的当前服务商 SLA。自定义创建器记录了独立 Facebook／LinkedIn 发布字段，因此应同时检查目标页面／账户、帖子及链接，不能只检查邮件。发布失败时，应先检查真实连接及活动状态；实读原文未确认自动重放、重试时间或统一跨渠道回滚。本次未连接或修改社交账户。

sections.title_en: A monthly price still carries an initial annual commitment
sections.title_zh: 月度标价仍附首次年度承诺
sections.en: Actual cards show Essential $199/month, Value $299 and Premium $499, with 500/3,000/10,000 contacts respectively and two managed email campaigns monthly in the table. The FAQ requires a twelve-month commitment before month-to-month billing terms. Compare the initial obligation as well as the monthly amount. Custom builder availability and additional services must be confirmed in the applicable offer; empty extracted feature cells do not prove inclusion. Exact taxes, overages, cancellation mechanics and a sustained free plan were not verified.
sections.zh: 实读卡片展示 Essential $199／月、Value $299、Premium $499，分别 500／3,000／10,000 联系人，表中包含每月两次托管邮件活动。FAQ 要求先承诺十二个月，此后转逐月。比较时应同时考虑初始义务和月金额。自定义创建器及额外服务须在适用方案确认；提取为空的功能单元格不能证明包含。未核实准确税费、超额费、取消机制或持续免费套餐。
